title: Offline-First PWA Support & ServiceWorker Resume Cache Engine (IndexedDB Draft Persistence, Background Sync, Fast Mobile Resume Viewer)
spec:
# DIR-038: Offline-First PWA Support & ServiceWorker Resume Cache Engine

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives (Enhancement Mandate)
Candidates frequently access their resumes, interview schedules, and job applications on mobile devices or in transit with intermittent network connectivity. Currently, loss of network connection can result in lost unsaved edits in the resume builder or an inability to display a resume during an in-person interview.

This directive implements a 10/10 **Offline-First Progressive Web App (PWA) & ServiceWorker Architecture**, featuring local IndexedDB draft auto-saving, ServiceWorker asset caching, background synchronization of pending edits, and an installable mobile experience.

## 2. Architecture Directives
1. **Progressive Web App Manifest & ServiceWorker**:
   - Web App Manifest: manifest.json with ResumePilotAI branding, app icons (192px, 512px, maskable), theme_color, background_color, and standalone display mode.
   - ServiceWorker: Cache static assets (CSS, JS bundles, Google Fonts, brand icons) with Cache-First strategy.
   - Network-First with Cache Fallback strategy for read-only user data (candidate profile, saved resumes).

2. **IndexedDB Resume Draft Persistence Engine**:
   - Automatically persist in-progress resume modifications into local IndexedDB (idb-keyval or Dexie) on every keystroke (debounced 300ms).
   - If network drops, display non-intrusive offline indicator: 'Offline Mode — Changes saved locally'.
   - When network restores, automatically sync pending changes to MariaDB with conflict resolution.

3. **Fast Mobile Offline Resume Viewer**:
   - Allow candidates to download and cache a certified PDF / HTML version of their primary resume for instant offline presentation.
   - 1-click 'Save for Offline Viewing' action in Candidate Resumes dashboard.

4. **PWA Install Banner & Lifecycle**:
   - Provide custom, non-intrusive Cuba M3 install prompt banner ('Install ResumePilotAI for Quick Access') triggered on eligible mobile and desktop browsers.

## 3. Acceptance Criteria
1. Web App Manifest validates with 100% score on Lighthouse PWA audit.
2. Candidate can continue editing resume with network disconnected; all changes persist to IndexedDB.
3. When network reconnects, background sync reconciles local edits to server seamlessly.
4. Cached resumes can be viewed and presented offline on mobile browsers without blank screens.
5. ServiceWorker updates automatically in background and prompts user with 'New Version Available — Reload'.
6. Zero loss of user work during simulated network drops or browser crashes.

## 4. Strict Invariants
1. Sensitive auth tokens in IndexedDB must be encrypted or scoped with strict origin boundaries.
2. Offline sync must never overwrite newer remote edits without notifying the candidate.
3. ServiceWorker must never cache sensitive administrative API responses or payment gateway URLs.
4. Ensure full compatibility with browsers that disable ServiceWorkers or IndexedDB.
invariants: Zero data loss on unexpected network disconnects or browser refreshes
ServiceWorker must never intercept or cache administrative or payment endpoints
Offline sync conflict resolution must favor candidate data preservation
Lighthouse PWA audit must score >= 90 without installation errors
acceptanceCriteria: PWA manifest and ServiceWorker install successfully with custom app icon
IndexedDB auto-saves resume changes instantly in offline mode
Background sync uploads local draft automatically upon network recovery
Primary resume viewable offline with high fidelity on mobile devices
Graceful update lifecycle with user reload notification for new deployments
